name: TOTP Turn Off
summary: Executes authenticated TOTP removal through the stable authentication flow boundary and emits the canonical disable-success transition.
notes: The existing POST /api/auth/mfadisable public contract is preserved while the server path is normalized through IAuthenticationFlowService.
The typed handler enforces that TOTP is actually enrolled and enabled before delegating to the real MFA manager.

sourceReferences.note: TurnOffTotpAsync is the application front door.
Typed handler enforces the canonical precondition and delegates to AppUserMfaManager.
